title: Autonomous wall time per usage
summary: A descriptive measure of autonomous wall time relative to a usage observation, with explicit provenance and no claim about model quality, cost or future throughput.
preconditions: Wall time is captured by an operator or trusted execution record.
Usage windows are identified and not silently combined.
procedure: Record wall time and usage provenance separately.
Use the measure only to compare governed development work.
decision_rules: Do not infer wall time from prompt count.
Do not convert the measure into a token or money claim.
stop_conditions: Stop if the interval is reconstructed, interrupted without a quality label or mixed with a reset window.
validation: Macro 03 execution metric records the Macro 02.2 wall time as operator-reported context without fabricating current-mission duration.
failure_modes: Treating a reset-separated quota window as a continuous measurement.
recovery: Preserve the original quality label and set derived comparisons to unavailable.

evidence_refs.claim: Wall time and quota quality are preserved literally.

confidence.rationale: Candidate descriptive measure based on one operator-reported mission record.
